text.tspan: "A name can be both a blessing and a curse.
Born into the prestigious Rosier family, Elias
has spent his life trying to outrun his own
name. A skilled duelist and arcane problem-
solver, he makes his living through cunning
and spellwork, offering his talents to those
who can afford them. Though he outwardly
rejects his lineage, the weight of his past
lingers—whispering of a destiny he cannot
